additional_info.subject: RE: ID0396795-DC/Si-D/PT-[GZj0fi]- MCCB Tripped CRM:00645000908
additional_info.body:
Hello Manuel,
Hope you are doing well.
Based on the log analysis, it appears that the issue with the MCCB tripping may have been related to the charger rebooting. The logs show that a hard reboot occurred, which could have caused the charger and power converters to power cycle. This process likely energized the capacitors inside the converters, potentially leading to the MCCB tripping during operation.
However, we are now observing the charging session without any issues, and the problem is not recurring. If you need further assistace please do notify us.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0396795-DC/Si-D/PT-[GZj0fi]- MCCB Tripped CRM:00645000908
additional_info.body:
Dear Beerpal,
Thank you for your email. My request asked for an escalation to L3 as we were already in contact with them.
The charger rebooting was an attempt to solve the issue, which turned out to be related to a poor connection on XD14 (it was loose and eventually interrupted the communication). Our team went to site and sorted this out, so you may close the ticket.
Appreciate your assistance.
With best regards,
